notes: v1.9.16 — SONGS NEXT-NEXT STOP: music player me gaane apne aap NEXT-NEXT nahi honge — pehle jab koi gaana load nahi hota tha to player chupchap agle-agle gaane pe jump karta tha (6 sec me 5+ gaane badal jate the). Ab 3 lagataar fail par player RUK jata hai aur saaf batata hai — 'Playback stopped — tap a song to retry'. Fail hone par thoda wait bhi karta hai (network recover hone do). Gaana khatam hone par agla gaana chalna (auto-next) pehle jaisa hi hai — wo normal music player behavior hai. v1.9.15 wala list-stable fix bhi isi me hai. versionCode 52
